caveats: ⛑ skill1 BOTH lines are SELF/ALLY damage-REDUCTION (Damage Taken ▼ on a Nikke), not a boss debuff. The engine's damageTakenPct is an ENEMY-side debuff stat (positive = boss takes more); there is no defensive damage-taken channel at scope lock (the boss deals no damage). Both blocks are authored with value 0 so they are provably inert while still recording the recovery-trigger shape and stack structure; the real magnitudes (14.14% / 8.43% × up to 5) live verbatim in unmodeled. Do NOT 'fix' these by writing the magnitudes in — a positive damageTakenPct here would fabricate a boss debuff the kit never grants.

⛑ skill1 line 1's target is the ALLY WHO HEALED Nero ("the target who cast the skill with recovery effect on Nero") — a reverse-causal, healer-identity target set with no TargetDef in the schema (no 'healer'/'lastHealer' kind). Even the correct target is unexpressible; combined with the inert-stat problem above the line is fully unmodeled.

⛑ Cat's Repayment stack count (max 5, 5 sec each) is the load-bearing GATE for the burst's Grumpy Cat line and for skill2's Grumpy-Cat-gated 158.05% rider — the whole kit chain is heal-driven. Nero receives no self-heal in her own kit, so the stack pool is entirely ally-sourced and UNKNOWABLE from kit text alone. No stack pool is modeled; the chain is therefore dark end-to-end.

⛑ skill2's 30%-on-attacked proc rate has no engine expression — there is no 'when attacked' trigger (the scope-lock boss deals no damage to Nikkes, so the trigger can never fire even if it existed). BOTH skill2 riders (the 8.26% Damage Taken ▲ boss debuff, which WOULD be a real team damage gain, and the 158.05% flatDamage) are therefore dark. The 8.26% line is the single largest unmodeled OFFENSIVE loss in this kit.
⛑ Attract (taunt) has no engine primitive and is scope-inert (no boss targeting model).

⛑ Burst 1104.91% is authored noFb:true per the standing rule that burst-cast/instant damage lands before the Full Burst window opens. It is a plain single-target hit: no core (the text says no core strike), crit at the caster's sheet rate (engine default), no range (burst-cast riders are force-set no-range).

⛑ Nero is a Burst II SMG Defender with essentially no offensive kit outside a single burst nuke. A sim total for her will be dominated by SMG normals + the burst hit; the modeled/unmodeled split above is a faithful reflection of that, not an omission.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⛑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Nero (nero) — SMG/Fire/Defender/Burst II, cd 20s, ammo 120, reload 99f, no charge, hitsPerShot 1, normal mult 8.39, core 200. MODELED: burst 1104.91% single-target flatDamage on burstCast (noFb per the pre-FB-landing rule); skill2's start-of-battle Max HP ▲ 60.28% as a self maxHpPct passive (kept per the HP/DEF-scaler prior — offensively inert today, live for any future atkOfMaxHpPct consumer, and it is the unit's own Max HP so it would feed one). NOT MODELED, with reasons in caveats: both skill1 Damage-Taken-▼ lines (defensive self/ally mitigation — the schema's damageTakenPct is the enemy-side debuff stat, so they are authored at value 0 and are provably inert rather than silently inverted into a fake boss debuff; line 1 additionally targets the HEALER, a target set the schema cannot express), both 30%-on-attacked skill2 riders (no 'when attacked' trigger exists and the scope-lock boss deals no damage, so neither the 8.26% boss Damage Taken ▲ nor the 158.05% Grumpy-Cat-gated hit can ever fire), the burst taunt (no primitive, scope-inert), and the burst's Grumpy Cat incoming-healing ▲ 60.08% (a healing-received multiplier with no HP pool at scope lock, gated on a Cat's Repayment stack pool that is entirely ally-heal-sourced and unmodeled). The kit is a heal-reactive defender chain: allies heal Nero → Cat's Repayment stacks → max stacks unlock Grumpy Cat → Grumpy Cat gates skill2's 158.05% rider. Nero self-heals nowhere in her own kit, so the entire chain's entry condition is external and cannot be derived from kit text. Highest-value measurement target: the skill2 8.26% Damage Taken ▲ boss debuff — it is the only line here that would move team damage, and it needs both an on-attacked trigger primitive and a proc-rate model.

audit.effectOrReason: Damage Taken ▼ 14.14%/5s on the ALLY WHO HEALED Nero. Two independent blockers: (a) the schema's damageTakenPct is an ENEMY-side debuff (positive = boss takes more damage) — there is no ally damage-mitigation stat, and the scope-lock boss deals no damage, so mitigation is inert by construction; (b) the target set 'the ally who cast the recovery on me' is reverse-causal healer identity, and no TargetDef kind expresses it. Block authored with value 0 to record the recovery-trigger shape without fabricating a boss debuff; verbatim text in unmodeled.skill1.

Self Damage Taken ▼ 8.43%, stacks to 5, 5s each, on recovery. Same stat-direction blocker as above (defensive mitigation, no channel; damageTakenPct would invert it into a fake boss debuff) — authored at value 0 with maxStacks 5 so the STACK STRUCTURE is on record. Load-bearing beyond its own mitigation: the stack count at max is the gate for the burst's Grumpy Cat, which in turn gates skill2's 158.05% rider. Nero has no self-heal, so stack accrual is entirely ally-sourced and unknowable from kit text; no stack pool modeled. Verbatim in unmodeled.skill1.

Damage Taken ▲ 8.26%/5s on the enemy — this IS a real boss debuff and WOULD raise whole-team damage (per the tandem/cross-unit rule it is never auto-skipped as 'defensive'). Blocked purely on trigger: there is no 'when attacked' TriggerDef, and at scope lock the boss deals no damage to Nikkes, so the activation condition never occurs in-sim regardless. The 30% proc rate has no expression either. Flagged as the highest-value offensive gap in this kit. Verbatim in unmodeled.skill2.

158.05% of final ATK damage rider, double-gated: (a) the same nonexistent 'when attacked' trigger at 30%, (b) Grumpy Cat status, which only exists after Cat's Repayment hits max stacks via the burst — i.e. downstream of the unmodeled ally-heal stack pool. Both gates dark; no trigger primitive and no stack model. Verbatim in unmodeled.skill2.

flags.estimate: 0 (deliberately inert); true kit magnitudes 14.14% and 8.43% × up to 5 stacks
flags.reasoning: Both lines are Damage Taken ▼ on a NIKKE (defensive mitigation). The only damage-taken stat in the schema, damageTakenPct, is documented as an enemy debuff where positive = boss takes MORE damage. Writing 14.14 or 8.43 there would invert a defensive line into a fabricated offensive boss debuff — exactly the fudge the prime directive forbids. Writing -14.14 would be equally wrong (it would REDUCE boss damage taken, a penalty the kit never applies). Value 0 keeps the block provably inert while preserving the recovery-trigger + 5-stack structure for audit. At scope lock the boss deals no damage to Nikkes, so no faithful encoding could move a number anyway.
flags.recipe: No measurement can resolve this in the current sim — it needs an engine primitive: a Nikke-side damage-mitigation stat plus a boss damage-output model. Until then the correct action is to leave value 0 and keep the magnitudes in unmodeled. If mitigation is ever modeled, re-read both lines fresh from kit text.

flags.estimate: self (stand-in); true target = the ally who cast the recovery on Nero
flags.reasoning: The kit says 'the target who cast the skill with recovery effect on Nero' — reverse-causal healer identity. No TargetDef kind expresses 'the unit that last healed me' (there is no 'healer'/'lastHealer'/'recoverySource'). Authored as self because the effect value is 0 and therefore provably inert regardless of target set, so the stand-in cannot move damage; choosing a wrong non-self target would be a silent misattribution if the value ever became live.
flags.recipe: Requires a schema addition (a healer-identity TargetDef) before it is authorable. If mitigation ever becomes a real channel, add the TargetDef first and re-derive the target from kit text — do not repurpose alliesLowestHp or a positional stand-in for it.

flags.estimate: UNKNOWABLE from kit text — plausibly 0 in any comp with no healer, up to 5 with a repeat-tick healer
flags.reasoning: Per the stack/currency prior a steady-state would normally be derived, but the accrual source here is EXTERNAL: Nero has no self-heal anywhere in her kit, so stacks come entirely from ally recovery events, at whatever rate that ally's kit emits them. That is a team-composition variable, not a kit constant — any single number would be fabricated. The stack count is load-bearing (max stacks → Grumpy Cat → skill2's 158.05% rider), so a guess here would silently gate a real damage line.
flags.recipe: If the mitigation/heal channel is ever modeled: instrument buffApply events for the Cat's Repayment key across the intended comp (a heal-over-time ally like a per-second recovery kit will pin stacks near 5; a single-instant-heal ally will sawtooth against the 5s window). Read stacks/maxStacks off the buffApply and time-average. Until a healer is actually in the graded comp the answer is 0.

flags.estimate: 0% in-sim (trigger can never fire); real-fight uptime unknown, bounded by 30% per incoming attack with a 5s window
flags.reasoning: This is the one genuinely OFFENSIVE line in the kit — a boss debuff that lifts whole-team damage, so the tandem/cross-unit rule forbids skipping it as defensive. It is blocked on a missing 'when attacked' trigger AND on the scope-lock boss dealing no damage. Estimating a nonzero uptime would fabricate team damage from a mechanic the sim cannot observe.
flags.recipe: Needs (1) a boss-attack-cadence model so 'when attacked' can fire, and (2) a proc-rate primitive for the 30%. Then measure against a real fight: run the comp with and without Nero and compare non-Nero unit totals — the 8.26% debuff should lift teammates' damage, isolating it from Nero's own contribution. Until both primitives exist this stays in unmodeled.

flags.reasoning: Standing rule from the methodology: burst-cast/instant damage is always FB-exempt because a burst cast lands before the Full Burst window opens. This is a rule-derived default, not a per-unit measurement — the ALWAYS-⛑ taxonomy's item (6) says per-kit noFb is measured-only, so it is flagged rather than shipped silently.
flags.recipe: Popup-read a Nero focus recording: compare her burst popup magnitude against the same shot in a rotation where the FB window is already open. A +50% delta would refute the exemption for this unit.

flags.estimate: datamined values as given — ammo 120, reloadFrames 99, hitsPerShot 1
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⛑ item (1): the cadence tuple comes from datamine fields (rate_of_fire, reloadFrames) that are known-unreliable, and a nominal rate is not the effective rate (the game fires on 60fps frame boundaries, so effective = 60/ceil(60/nominal)). Nero's normals will dominate her non-burst total, so cadence error propagates directly into her sim number.
flags.recipe: Ammo-counter read on a Nero focus recording: count rounds spent per second over a full magazine to get shots/sec directly, and time the reload from empty to full. Do NOT infer cadence from full-burst counts — that is downstream of gauge, not of fire rate.
